§6Rocket Monitoring Station§f displays real-time status of every linked AR rocket, altitude, fuel level, oxygen, hull integrity, and crew status. It is a Network Machine that can be linked to a Planet Holo Selector or Guidance Computer.

Craft it: Copper Sticks, Satellite Primary Function, Machine Structure, and a Battery in the pattern 'c o c / c b c / c p c'. It uses a Data Bus to communicate with linked rockets.

The station can also send Redstone signals when a rocket enters or leaves a zone, enabling automated launch and recovery systems.

§ePS:§f Place within 32 blocks of the rockets it tracks, beyond that the Data Bus signal degrades. Use a Linker to bind the station to a Planet Holo Selector for fleet status on the holographic globe.
